answer: An agent's behavior fingerprint unlocks its escrowed deposit like pigment settling into a canvas: each honest act adds a shade, and only a stable pattern releases funds. A falcon-fast newcomer claiming reputation must wait 20 epochs of steady work with its 40-unit bond locked. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4000 units frozen against a prize pool of only 900, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once and see the deposit echo back.
